messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Tell your doctor about all your current medicines, especially a blood thinner such as warfarin, Coumadin, or Jantoven.
Many drugs may interact with escitalopram.
Some drugs should not be used at the same time.
Tell your doctor about all your current medicines and any medicine you start or stop using.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
